name: Coolify
description: Your Coolify in Swarm: what's running and deploying, every deployment and its log, rollbacks, env vars and servers; Deploy beside each thread of a project Coolify runs; and agents that deploy, fix failed builds and set up new apps.

settings.title: Coolify URL
settings.description: The address you open Coolify's dashboard at. Coolify's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: API token
settings.description: From Coolify: Keys & Tokens, API tokens. Coolify's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: Agents' key
settings.description: The key the agents' MCP requests carry to the plugin, never Coolify's token. Coolify's page of Settings makes it.

settings.title: Agents with Coolify's MCP server
settings.description: The agents Coolify's MCP server was added to, by ID.
